name: ZenBusiness
summary: US business-formation service — LLC, S corp and C corp filings with no service fee beyond the state's own, and the money in the recurring stack around it: registered agent, compliance service, operating agreement and EIN, each priced individually rather than bundled into tiers.
best_for: first-time founders who want the paperwork handled and are willing to pay a yearly fee to keep it handled — the a-la-carte pricing means you can start at the state fee plus a registered agent and add only what you actually need
skip_if: you are comfortable filing with your state yourself and acting as your own registered agent. In that case the state fee is the only unavoidable cost, and the $199/year is buying convenience and a business address rather than anything you cannot do. Also skip it if you need legal advice rather than filing, since a formation service is not a law firm
honest_knock: The $0 is real for the filing service and it is also the whole commercial idea: what you sign up for at zero has an annual carry that is not shown next to it. A registered agent is a legal requirement in every state, and theirs is $199/year — so the realistic first-year cost of 'the $0 LLC' is the state fee plus $199, before compliance filing at another $199/year. Price the second year, not the first. The second thing to hold in view is that the state fee is the largest and most variable number in the whole exercise, and ZenBusiness cannot change it. It is set by your state, ranges widely, and their own page sends you to a lookup rather than quoting it. Anyone comparing formation services on the advertised price alone is comparing the small half of the bill.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a year and Worry-Free Compliance $199 a year
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on zenbusiness.com/pricing-products/, where /pricing/ now redirects; every one of the sixteen published amounts unchanged since 25 Jul 2026) Formation itself is $0 plus the state's fee — that applies to LLC, S corp and C corp filings alike, and the state fee is separate, varies by state and is not shown until you pick one. Everything else is priced as its own line rather than bundled into plan tiers. The recurring items are registered agent at $199/year, Worry-Free Compliance Filing at $199/year, and Advanced Compliance Protection at $299/year. One-time filings: operating agreement $99, EIN $99, business document templates $99, rush filing $79 and DBA registration $95 plus state fees. Then business licence report $149, amendment $100, certificate of good standing $100, annual report filing $100 per report, and New York publication $200 for the state that requires it. There is a second catalogue alongside the legal one: business website $129/year, eCommerce website $279/year, business email address $25/year, domain $25/year, domain privacy $10/year, logo kit $60, business banking $5/month and Money Pro with online payments $30/month.
